description: The bar chart illustrates how many tweets fall into each category of “Number of labels” (interpreted in the caption as the number of sentiments associated with a tweet). The horizontal axis contains the categories and is labeled “Number of labels,” shown as discrete integers in ascending order from 0 through 5 (with visible bars for 0–4 and no visible bar at 5). The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Number of tweets,” displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0 up to just under 500,000, with regularly spaced tick marks at approximately 100,000-tweet intervals (0, 100,000, 200,000, 300,000, 400,000). Five vertical bars are shown: at 0 labels, a short blue bar near the baseline (on the order of only a few thousand tweets); at 1 label, a tall orange bar reaching roughly 470,000 tweets; at 2 labels, a tall green bar reaching roughly 410,000 tweets; at 3 labels, a red bar reaching just under 100,000 tweets (around ~95,000); and at 4 labels, a short purple bar near the baseline (again on the order of a few thousand tweets). The bars are not stacked or grouped beyond being single bars per category, there is no legend, and no bars appear to be specially emphasized beyond their distinct colors.
